methodSections.heading: Earl Grey White Chocolate Mousse
steps: Separate the eggs into yolks and whites, and whip the cream to stiff peaks.
Heat the milk in a small saucepan, add the Earl Grey tea, remove from heat, and allow to steep for 20 minutes.
Melt the chocolate gently over a bain marie (double boiler). Add the steeped milk and stir until fully combined. Remove from the heat and allow to cool slightly.

Temper the egg yolks into the milk chocolate mixture. Tempering egg is achieved by slowly adding a tiny bit of yolk to the warm mixture at a time and whisking constantly. Keep mixing until fully incorporated.
Whip the egg whites into firm peaks and then fold into chocolate mixture.
Fold the chocolate egg mixture into the whipped cream.
Transfer to a container or piping bag and cool until set.

methodSections.heading: Citrus Yogurt
steps: Split and scrape the vanilla bean and mix all ingredients together.

methodSections.heading: Citrus Salad
steps: Segment all the citrus fruit and place in a bowl. Toss together in the cinnamon and sugar. Add torn mint and toss to combine.

methodSections.heading: Madeleine Sponge Cake
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F) with fan on. Line 22x30cm (9x12in) pan with parchment paper and spray with cooking spray.
Whisk the flour, salt and baking powder together into a bowl.
Place the sugar, zest and eggs into a stand mixer and beat at medium-high until light and fluffy. Add the milk and beat to combine.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl, add the dry ingredients and mix until smooth.
Add the lemon juice, butter and honey, one at a time, mixing thoroughly and scraping down the bowl between each addition. Beat on high until the batter is light.
Spread evenly into the lined baking pan and bake for 7-10 minutes, rotating halfway through.
Remove from the oven and allow to cool on a wire rack.
Portion the cake as desired and serve with the Earl Grey mousse, Citrus Salad and Citrus Yogurt. Garnish with dried citrus wedges and torn mint.
